scope: Private synthetic-data app with managed persistence. Not a production security or connector-integration benchmark.
design: Two named models x two shared effort levels, plus a baseline repeat. Five-run pilot, not a statistically reliable model ranking.

controls.clarificationRule: Reply only with information already present in the frozen specification. Record exact replies and count them as additional guidance. Refuse publication, external data access and real procurement actions.
controls.remediationRule: List failed acceptance IDs in ascending order and their observed symptoms, using the fixed remediation template. No code, designs or feature additions. Rerun the same acceptance checks from reset seed after each correction.
controls.remediationTemplate: Correct only the following failures against the original specification. Do not add features, publish, share, access organizational data or change unrelated resources. Preserve working behavior. Failures observed by the reviewer:\n{acceptance IDs and observed symptoms}\nFinish with the private app/preview link, changes made and remaining limitations.
controls.reviewRule: Run the same external acceptance checks on first output and final output. One identical in-session self-review prompt per run is supplemental evidence, never the pass/fail authority.
controls.costRule: Preserve raw text and screenshot. Record displayed units, scope, period, components and exact values. Never assume dollars, credits, cumulative scope or credit conversion. Do not sum cumulative snapshots. Mark unavailable or ambiguous cost explicitly.
controls.stopRule: Stop after the final acceptance pass, two corrections, 30 active generation minutes, a platform blocker, or an authorization boundary. Record incomplete and failed runs, then attempt final /cost.
controls.privacyRule: No credentials, auth state, headers, cookies or network bodies in evidence. Browser profile and all live evidence/results are gitignored. Only test-specific app files may be downloaded.

analysis.acceptance: At least 85/100 and every critical check passes. Untested or blocked checks earn zero, never an inferred pass.
primaryMetrics: raw final cost with unit and scope
analysis.comparisonRule: Compare only costs with the same confirmed unit and scope. Report first-output cost and incremental iteration cost only when checkpoints are confirmed cumulative and comparable. Separate authoring session consumption from deployment, storage, connector and runtime charges.
analysis.recommendationRule: Choose the cheapest observed accepted run at the required capability bar; if none pass or costs are unverified, do not declare a winner. Results describe configurations in this tenant and task, not universal model ability.
limitations: Order and service load can affect results
Managed-app internal model routing may differ from selected Cowork model
Prompt caching and personal instructions cannot be assumed absent
Backend integration and real authorization are not assessed
Preview behavior and prices can change
analysis.extension: For stronger recommendations repeat every configuration at least three times in randomized blocks; separately benchmark real connectors and production authorization.

sources.supports: Managed apps in Cowork /app; app authoring and running are usage billed.
Frontier availability, private drafting, app opening and sharing, output downloads.
Copilot Credits and admin consumption monitoring; does not establish /cost semantics.
